thresholds.scale_note: Pump.fun runs ~5-15x Solada's holder counts and ~4-8x its pool depth in USD terms; thresholds scaled accordingly.

L3.flow: h6 buys > sells AND h1 buys >= sells
L3.first_fade: has had a >=30% pullback from post-graduation high, price still >=40% of that high, holders not bleeding (>=-3% vs prior snapshot)

thresholds.farm_filter_L1: Any of: >=10 identical balances among pump.fun top-50; GeckoTerminal holder count <10% of pump.fun count (or vice versa); liq/mcap <2%; h6 buy:sell count >5:1 with sub-$1 fills; clone txn counts across tickers => Pass (sybil/wash).

thresholds.selection: 5-10 names per run (recent graduates/near-graduates + GeckoTerminal/pump.fun trending); paper-trade L3+ plus the run's strongest L2; max 2 new tickets per run; no duplicates (one open ticket per mint).

rules.rule: Watch (L3) needs early holder density that holds through the first fade (>=1,500 holders after a >=30% pullback, no holder bleed); an mcap spike alone isn't enough.
Graduation alone isn't a signal; on Pump.fun most graduates bleed or are farmed. Score the post-migration PumpSwap pool, not the graduation event.
Price rising with flat holders = Tiny lottery (L2) at best.
First-block snipers/bundles (same-slot-as-create buyers, or pump.fun isSniper/isBundler flags) = rotation risk; >20% of supply bought in the create slot caps the name at L2.
First-block sniper/bundle full exit = kill trigger; if already hit before entry, no ticket (a paper entry shouldn't open below its own kill line).

Paper tickets need a meaningful holder base (>=500 L2 / >=1,500 L3), pool depth (>=85 / >=200 SOL quote side) and buys > sells over h6 (and h1 for L3). Names with h6 price down >40% are Pass regardless of 24h headline gains.

rules.rule: Sybil/wash farm filter: identical balances across many top holders, holder-count mismatch between sources, liq/mcap <2% or lopsided tiny-fill buy counts = Pass. RST, TRUTH, SARP (and GDF/XBC/GOIF/DNA/UDTF/FTR-fire clones) showed this on Oct 17.
Copycat tickers (several FTR mints live) mark peak attention for the original; don't ticket a copy because the original ran.
